items.title: NSE reviewing network vulnerabilities as AI cyber threats rise: Chauhan
items.description: NSE chief Ashish Kumar Chauhan urged stockbrokers to make cybersecurity a core function and called for an industry task force to identify and address emerging risks

items.title: Sebi reviews short selling, SLB rules; plans AI sandbox, bond market-making
items.description: The regulator is also finalising responsible AI guidelines, developing graded broker compliance norms and working on measures to improve capital efficiency and supervision
